name: development
description: Development methodology toolkit with Agile team delivery for large, long-horizon features. The agile-development skill coordinates thin end-to-end slices, durable progress state, architecture and test-plan critique, manual testing before automated regression coverage, verification, and final review. Includes Architect, Test Planner, Manual Tester, Developer, Critic, and blind-spot agents; design-first brainstorming; autonomous design; scenario-driven development as the default testing flow (scenario manual testing, then regression tests, then coverage-guided tests), with TDD as an explicit opt-in; subagent-driven execution; course-correction when fixes stack; compound-learning lessons read back at plan time; hooks that block git bypasses and untested completion; completion verification; code-review triage; work-item drafting; and provider-agnostic work-on and implement workflows.
